headline: Thailand seeks US tariff reduction under Section 301 following trade talks
summary: Thailand plans to request a reduction in US Section 301 tariffs related to forced labor to 10% from 12.5%, matching rates applied to regional peers Cambodia, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
why: US Section 301 trade tariffs affect market access and export price competitiveness for Southeast Asian manufacturing and processing industries.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Lowering Section 301 tariffs to 10% would improve Thai exporter parity with ASEAN peers.
